public_body: Department Of Early Education And Care Provider Working Team
overall: The Provider Working Team is a Department focus group that cannot act collectively, so it is not a public body under the OML and no violation was found.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Early Education and Care Provider Working Team broke the OML by refusing to post agendas and open its meetings to the public.
allegations.key_passage: However, because the PWT is not a body empowered to act collectively, we find that it is not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.
